purpose: Live interactive 60-minute birthday trivia app with TanStack Start/Vite, an Effect domain, and a Cloudflare room Worker.
identitySource: git rev-parse HEAD, git status --short --branch, and repo-structure.render.json

representativeJobs.acceptedOutcome: The home route renders the seven-section 60-minute trivia agenda.
A development-stage remote room can join teams, start, advance, score, and finish while all views share state.
The HTTP boundary returns a Schema-decoded trivia section catalogue.
The RPC client invokes the Schema-owned section operations through its handler Layer.

boundaryFacts: The home, host, join, and display routes are owned by apps/web.
The domain owns section and room Schemas, typed failures, and the pure room reducer.
Browser HTTP uses Fetch; server loaders use the in-process HTTP client; live room state uses the Worker RPC/HTTP adapter through Effect Atom.
Alchemy and Cloudflare state requires approved provider readback; repository configuration owns desired state only.
Doppler may inject future provider credentials at command runtime; no repository secret file is an authority source.
Pinned Effect and Alchemy source references are read-only Git submodules under .references/.
exclusions: Generated route trees, dependencies, build output, caches, binaries, secret values, live provider inventories, and inaccessible external systems.
nonClaims: Local verification does not prove preview, production, provider, release, deployment, or publication behaviour.
The development-stage remote room journey does not prove production behaviour.
Alchemy configuration is desired state and does not prove a deployed Cloudflare resource.
